description: Flood — Awareness — Property Parcel Metrics is a dataset listed in Brisbane City Council open data portal (data.brisbane.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. This table includes the report metrics that are used by the Flood Awareness Map solution to generate a report for each parcel (property lot) and property holding in Brisbane City Council local government area. Coverage: Brisbane, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are arcgis, environment, property and planning, spatial data, creek flood. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
